title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-routing-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Evan Kim
description: Motivation: Dedicated fleet customers asked for more predictable throughput guarantees during transient spikes while preserving long-term utilization. This change extends the dedicated autoscaler with: 1) priority-aware routing so high-tier customers can borrow burst capacity using bounded preemption; 2) a token-bucket based burst smoothing layer to avoid oscillatory scale-ups; 3) newly instrumented utilization and burst metrics that feed Redwood Console reports and alerting. What I changed (high level): - autoscaler: add priority routing policy + preemption hooks; implement token-bucket smoothing with configurable refill rates and max-burst per-priority. - telemetry: emit dedicated.fleet.utilization, dedicated.fleet.burst_tokens, dedicated.fleet.preemptions and per-priority throughput guarantees; add labels for customer_tier and capacity_pool. - config: introduce new schema fields under dedicated.autoscaler.{priority_pools,burst_smoothing,throughput_guarantees} with defaults and compatibility layer for existing configs. - rollout: add feature flag (feature.dedicated.autoscaler.priority_routing) and a canary rollout that ramps from 0 to 100% across dedicated clusters. - docs: update 'Dedicated autoscaler' guide and release notes. - tests: unit tests for token-bucket math, e2e integration test exercising priority routing across two capacity pools. Why this approach: Token-bucket smoothing reduces thrash when sudden bursts hit the autoscaler and gives predictable short-term throughput guarantees. Priority routing + bounded preemption lets us offer tiered SLAs without statically partitioning capacity. The metrics allow ops and customers to correlate cost/latency regressions with burst consumption. Compatibility notes: defaults preserve current autoscaler behavior unless feature flag is enabled or new config keys provided. Backwards-compatible migration path included for existing dedicated deployments. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (ENG-1024) - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] telemetry validated locally - [x] docs updated - [x] canary rollout plan included

release_notes: Enhanced dedicated autoscaler with priority routing and burst smoothing. New metrics (dedicated.fleet.utilization, dedicated.fleet.burst_tokens, dedicated.fleet.preemptions) available in Console. Backwards-compatible; enabled via feature flag or new config.
